main_measure.name: mean next-day unusual move (close[t+1]/close[t]-1 minus coin mean daily return) over bars with forecast > 0

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases of one day pooled

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and slope > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2 or slope < 0 with t <= -2

supporting_check.name: slope of next-day unusual move on forecast (day-pooled t)

decided_by: Confirm: the mean unusual move is above 0 with t >= 2 and the slope is positive with t >= 2.
reading: Cases are every bar with forecast > 0 and a next close in the same window, the drift is the coin's mean 1-bar return over all its windows, day pooling uses per-day sums of deviations (mean) or of scores (OLS slope) with a D/(D-1) correction, and the plan's 'fewer than 30 distinct case days' is applied as a minimum count giving 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.002401 on the check folds against +0.007035 on every fold
